minutes.headline: PACC voted to recommend the cable manager's job become exempt with equivalent pay, amended to a grade 14 minimum.
minutes.summary: The committee approved minutes, heard the manager's monthly report, and drafted bullet points for a year-to-date report to the Select Board on Nov 28. The main item was a motion recommending the manager position be changed from non-exempt to exempt, which was amended and then voted on. A term-date error on the town website was also flagged for correction.

votes.motion: Accept the minutes of the 2nd of October.
Authorize the chair/manager to turn the bullet points into a presentation for the Select Board on 28 November.
Recommend the position of manager of the public access cable department be changed from non-exempt to exempt, comparable to other department heads, at an equivalent salary.
Friendly amendment: equivalent salary of at least grade 14, deleting the overtime and benefits language.
Vote on the amended version of the motion.
Vote on the motion as presented (a member said they liked the concept but not the wording).

The quarterly fee has not arrived because town finance is behind, and indirect costs have not been posted yet.
The bonds generated interest in one quarter, listed as an accomplishment.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to recommend that the cable manager position change from non-exempt to exempt, with pay of at least grade 14; the vote counts were not audible.
A friendly amendment set the salary floor at grade 14 and dropped the overtime and benefits language from the motion.
A second vote on the motion as originally worded was also taken, after a member said they liked the concept but not the wording; counts were not audible.
The committee authorized the manager to turn its year-to-date bullet points into a presentation for the Select Board on 28 November.
A term-date error on the town website is to be corrected after Pete sends the right dates to Joe; no motion was needed.

why_it_matters: The exempt change would take overtime pay off the table for the cable manager position, and the committee found the salary line would run slightly over its present budget, with indirect-cost savings expected to cover it.
The motion is only a recommendation, so any change to the position's status and pay still rests with the Select Board and the town.
